summary: The server components are now named Arco Engine, Arco Bridge, Arco Gateway, Arco Orchestrator, Arco Launcher, Arco Admin Control, and Arco Credential.
details: On the PC that hosts the Arco Server folder, setup starts Arco Launcher, which replaces the old ArcRho Launcher entry in your Startup folder.
Saves that wait on the Engine now recognise the "Arco Engine service is not available" message again.
